The arithmetic on every estimate

1,000 sq ft × 1 in × 0.623 = 623 gallons.

That is one ordinary inch of rain on a small roof. Your gutters and downspouts have to carry every gallon of it, all winter long.

Where 623 gallons go

Follow one inch of rain from the shingles to the yard.

  1. 01

    The roof sheds it.

    A thousand square feet of roof, one inch of rain. All of it slides to the edge and into the trough.

    into the gutter623 gal

  2. 02

    One 2x3 drop takes it all.

    A single small downspout at the far corner. The trough backs up and the water spills over the front, right where you walk.

    one 2x3 drop623 gal

  3. 03

    A second drop, both 3x4.

    Split the run and widen the pipe. Each drop carries half, and the gutter drains before it can fill.

    two 3x4 drops312 gal each

  4. 04

    Turned away from the wall.

    An elbow and an extension onto a splash block, so the water lands in the yard instead of the crawl space.

    at the foundation0 gal

Eight jobs, one method

Everything we do starts with how much water it has to carry.

Every estimate lists the roof planes, the gallons per inch of rain and the gallons each downspout takes. If the 5-inch is enough for your garage, we will say so.

  1. 01

    Gutter sizing and replacement

    New seamless gutters sized by the gallons your roof sheds, not by habit.

    Price it
  2. 02

    Downspout upsizing

    2x3 downspouts swapped for 3x4 where one drop carries too much of the roof.

    Price it
  3. 03

    Gutter cleaning

    Fall and late-winter cleaning of needles, moss and leaves, with each downspout flow-tested.

    Price it
  4. 04

    Moss treatment at the roof edge

    Moss brushed off the bottom shingle courses so it stops washing into the gutter.

    Price it
  5. 05

    Gutter guards

    Micro-mesh guards for fir needles, tested with a hose before the crew leaves.

    Price it
  6. 06

    Leak and seam repair

    Dripping corners, end caps and old seams resealed and checked in a steady rain.

    Price it
  7. 07

    Rain barrels and rain gardens

    Downspouts routed to a rain barrel or a rain garden overflow, sized to the roof.

    Price it
  8. 08

    Fascia and soffit repair

    Wet or rotted fascia and soffit boards replaced before gutters are hung again.

    Price it

Tool 02 5-inch or 6-inch?

Roof pitch
Heavy rain where you live

5-inch is usually enough. A side this size sheds a moderate stream. A clean 5-inch with enough drops carries it.

A rule of thumb. We confirm it with a tape on the visit.
